facts.text: Mount Otemanu serves as the backdrop to the resort.
facts.excerpt: With Mount Otemanu serving as a backdrop

facts.text: The resort offers the most overwater bungalows on the island.
facts.excerpt: Offering the most overwater bungalows on the island, some with private saltwater plunge pools, alongside spacious beachside villas

facts.text: Sixty-two overwater bungalows and villas have their own saltwater plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Sixty-two of our Bora Bora overwater bungalows and villas come with their own saltwater plunge pool.

facts.text: Overwater bungalows have the largest glass-paneled floors in Bora Bora for viewing marine life.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy marine life without leaving your bungalow with the largest glass-paneled floors in Bora Bora

facts.text: Overwater bungalows have a modern design with Polynesian accents.
facts.excerpt: Inside, you’ll be surrounded by a modern design infused with striking Polynesian accents.

facts.text: Villas have a freestanding bathtub with lagoon views.
facts.excerpt: Gaze upon the blue lagoon from the luxury of a freestanding bathtub in your Bora Bora villa

facts.text: The resort has an infinity pool with Otemanu views and the Te Ava swim-up bar.
facts.excerpt: Relax by our infinity pool with Otemanu views or sip at Te Ava.

facts.text: Guests can encounter rescued and rehabbing turtles at the Eco Centre.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy captivating encounters with rescued and rehabbing turtles at our Eco Centre.

facts.text: Every visit to the Heavenly Spa includes the Three Stones Ritual.
facts.excerpt: And every visit is enhanced with our Three Stones Ritual where you can center yourself and focus on hope, gratitude, and love.

facts.text: Sunrise yoga is held once a week on the main beach facing Mount Otemanu, and paddleboard yoga is offered.
facts.excerpt: Join in an invigorating ritual offered once a week on our main beach for sunrise yoga under the majestic gaze of Mount Otemanu.

facts.text: Cultural classes include coconut palm weaving, shell craft, flower crown weaving and Tahitian dance.
facts.excerpt: Get instruction on coconut palm weaving, shell craft, flower crown weaving and Tahitian Dance classes.

facts.text: A weekly Polynesian show celebrates traditional dress, dance, music and food.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the spectacle of our weekly Polynesian show. It’s a celebration of traditional dress, dance, music, and food

facts.text: Maere's head chef creates a new themed menu every evening, with views of the lagoon.
facts.excerpt: Maere features a menu that our head chef creates anew every evening, with a distinct theme for each

facts.text: Manahere is an overwater dining venue for private events, intimate dinners and romantic occasions.
facts.excerpt: This is Manahere, our exclusive overwater dining venue for private events, intimate dinners, and romantic occasions.

facts.text: Guests can snorkel in the lagoon, paddleboard and kayak, and play beach volleyball, badminton and beach tennis.
facts.excerpt: Go for an invigorating swim, snorkel in the lagoon, or paddle an SUPs or kayaks. When you hit the sand, play beach volleyball, beach badminton, and beach tennis.

facts.text: The resort was previously known as Le Meridien Bora Bora.
facts.excerpt: Previously known as Le Méridien Bora Bora, the Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa underwent an extensive renovation and rebranding
